cases.baselineFailureRationale: A generic memory feedback packet can mention helped/hurt without preserving activation downgrade semantics.

knowledgeReadModels.title: Helped feedback memory application
knowledgeReadModels.summary: Memory application feedback records helped, hurt, neutral, and stale outcomes without automatic promotion.
knowledgeReadModels.falsifier: A memory apply command mutates Memory Core directly.
knowledgeReadModels.doesNotProve: This does not prove arbitrary memory usefulness.

cases.baselineFailureRationale: A naive recall can reuse hurt memory wording without excluding it before activation.

knowledgeReadModels.title: Hurt feedback activation exclusion
knowledgeReadModels.summary: Repeated hurt feedback should downgrade future activation instead of silently reusing stale context.
knowledgeReadModels.falsifier: A downgraded memory remains included after repeated hurt feedback.
knowledgeReadModels.doesNotProve: This does not prove broad forget quality.

cases.baselineFailureRationale: A loose usefulness match can select helped feedback without evidenceRef and doesNotProve requirements.

knowledgeReadModels.title: Knowledge usefulness evidence link
knowledgeReadModels.summary: Retained knowledge usefulness needs outcome, reason, evidenceRef, and doesNotProve before helped feedback.
knowledgeReadModels.falsifier: A knowledge usefulness capture omits evidenceRef but records helped feedback.
knowledgeReadModels.doesNotProve: This does not prove automatic pattern learning.

cases.baselineFailureRationale: A source-decision query can match generic source vocabulary while missing consumer and falsifier.

knowledgeReadModels.title: Source-to-decision retention gate
knowledgeReadModels.summary: Retained sources must name source, mechanism, KRN implication, decision, consumer, falsifier, and non-proof.
knowledgeReadModels.falsifier: A source decision is retained with no consumer.
knowledgeReadModels.doesNotProve: This does not prove source truth.

cases.query: source graph relation edge temporal readback
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Graph relation terminology can be confused with source truth unless the boundary packet remains selected.

knowledgeReadModels.title: Graph relation readback boundary
knowledgeReadModels.summary: Expose SourceClaimEdge relation readback without treating graph relation support as source truth.
knowledgeReadModels.falsifier: Graph relationSupport is presented as proof of source truth.
knowledgeReadModels.doesNotProve: This does not prove graph ranking quality.

sourceClaims.claim: Source graph relation support is useful readback but not truth proof.
sourceClaims.mechanism: SourceClaimEdge rows expose relation summaries for inspection.
sourceClaims.krnImplication: Brain search should surface graph boundary guidance before graph tuning.
sourceClaims.falsifier: Relation support is treated as accepted source truth.
sourceClaims.doesNotProve: This does not prove source truth.

cases.query: accepted sourceclaim sourcedecisionedge support missing link
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Accepted SourceClaim wording can outrank decision-link provenance if the missing-link caveat is not retained.

knowledgeReadModels.title: Accepted source decision link readback
knowledgeReadModels.summary: Accepted SourceClaims need visible SourceDecisionEdge support or an explicit missing-link caveat in readback.
knowledgeReadModels.falsifier: An accepted SourceClaim is called decision-supported with no decision edge.
knowledgeReadModels.doesNotProve: This does not prove accepted claims are true.

sourceClaims.claim: Accepted claims require decision-link readback before strong authority wording.
sourceClaims.mechanism: SourceDecisionEdge support separates accepted-only lifecycle from decision provenance.
sourceClaims.krnImplication: Brain search should keep accepted-only caveats visible.
sourceClaims.falsifier: Brain search hides missing decision-link evidence.
sourceClaims.doesNotProve: This does not prove source truth.

cases.query: second opinion claude governed verdict diff hash
cases.baselineFailureRationale: A review process packet can match second-opinion wording while missing governed JSON and diff freshness.

knowledgeReadModels.title: Second opinion governed review
knowledgeReadModels.summary: Headless Claude review must return validator-governed JSON with diff freshness and evidence refs.
knowledgeReadModels.falsifier: A slice trusts prose review output with no validated verdict JSON.
knowledgeReadModels.doesNotProve: This does not prove Claude judgment is correct.

cases.query: target repo owner file recall below roots
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Generic target repo planning can outrank explicit owner-file read-model evidence.

knowledgeReadModels.title: Target owner-file read model
knowledgeReadModels.summary: Target owner-file recall should use explicit read-model evidence below named target roots.
knowledgeReadModels.falsifier: KRN static owner-file recall leaks into target projects.
knowledgeReadModels.doesNotProve: This does not prove broad target repo readiness.

cases.query: store only source evidence selected knowledge
cases.baselineFailureRationale: A catalog-only baseline has no readModel, so the case requires source-search selected knowledge.

sourceClaims.claim: Store-only brain search can derive selected knowledge from governed source evidence.
sourceClaims.mechanism: Source search returns accepted SourceClaim fields with reviewability metadata.
sourceClaims.krnImplication: Brain search can surface source-backed context without file catalog readModels.
sourceClaims.falsifier: Store-only brain search returns empty selectedKnowledge despite ready source evidence.
sourceClaims.doesNotProve: This does not prove broad ranking quality.

cases.baselineFailureRationale: Generic retained KRN guardrails mention quality gates but are not EKOLOGUS target evidence.

sourceClaims.claim: EKOLOGUS target README defines a project-specific quality gate.
sourceClaims.mechanism: Target-specific source evidence contains the distinctive target token.
sourceClaims.krnImplication: Use target-specific source evidence before generic KRN guardrails.
sourceClaims.falsifier: Only generic guardrails are selected for an EKOLOGUS target query.
sourceClaims.doesNotProve: This does not prove broad target repo readiness.

sourceClaims.claim: Retained KRN knowledge must preserve source, mechanism, consumer, and falsifier.
sourceClaims.mechanism: Generic governance packets keep source decisions reviewable.
sourceClaims.krnImplication: Treat this as a guardrail, not target evidence.
sourceClaims.falsifier: A retained decision omits the falsifier field.
sourceClaims.doesNotProve: This does not prove EKOLOGUS source evidence.

cases.query: plan brief memory advantage comparator rendered codex brief
cases.baselineFailureRationale: A local-test closure packet can mention plans and briefs but misses rendered Codex brief memory/source evidence.

knowledgeReadModels.title: Plan brief memory advantage comparator
knowledgeReadModels.summary: Memory advantage eval must prove no-memory plan brief miss and KRN memory/source rendered Codex brief hit.
knowledgeReadModels.falsifier: The eval passes without rendered MemoryRecord or SourceClaim ids in the Codex brief readback.
knowledgeReadModels.doesNotProve: This does not prove arbitrary Codex output quality.

knowledgeReadModels.title: Local tests alone closeout
knowledgeReadModels.summary: Focused local tests can close a tiny slice but do not replace second-opinion or plan brief proof for larger kernel eval changes.
knowledgeReadModels.falsifier: A large memory eval slice closes from local tests without proof/non-proof or reviewer evidence.
knowledgeReadModels.doesNotProve: This does not prove plan brief memory advantage.
